notes.title: PIGFACE - EARLY ACCESS AUGUST 2025
notes.content:
[h3][b]EARLY ACCESS AUGUST 2025[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]What a two-for-one special, eh? A really cool demo, quickly followed up by a PC Gaming Show Early Access reveal trailer … [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MkmsDd-IiUg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]I’m [i]still [/i]picking up the bits of my pants that were blown off.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Anyways, as I’m sure you’re aware, PIGFACE is slated for an August EA release, so if you liked the demo you’re probably pretty damn happy. By the time that month rolls around, these forum posts are going to start discussing content updates to the game. [/p][p]
[/p][p]What I’m really looking forward to with EA are the reactions to the new levels — as much as the demo was dark and dismal, I want a handful of PIGFACE’s locations to be explored during the day. In the first content update you’ll get to see a daytime level that I think you’re all [i]really [/i]going to like. It’s one of my personal favourites and actually one of the first level ideas I even had for this project waaaaay back in 2022.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Along with the content updates, the levels are also going to get bigger and more interesting as you expand your loadout and find more masks that alter the way you approach the game. Basically it’s just gonna be even [i]more [/i]exciting stuff.[/p][p]
[/p][p]I hope you guys liked the demo, and I hope you’re excited to see what I’ve got planned for the content updates during Early Access. This game is gonna be really fuckin’ fun, man.[/p][p]
[/p][p]~ Tito[/p]
